unit-disallowed-list.message: rem is banned in src/ (CLAUDE.md, token-layer proposal): a rem value means a different pixel size depending on where it's read. Use a var(--fs-*)/var(--space-*) token, or a literal px value in src/index.css.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: One file authors design values (src/index.css) — every *.module.css must reference a var(--*) token instead of a literal colour, px font-size, px spacing, or px radius. See the token-layer proposal (design-tokens branch) §enforce. If this is a genuine pixel-perfect exception (a visually-hidden technique, an env() safe-area fallback), disable this rule for the one line with a comment explaining why, not repo-wide.
